About this item

  • Genuine Leather Design: The leather is soft, smooth, and durable, hand-stitched, making it unique and beautiful overall.
  • Handmade Customized: Each journal is crafted by artisans who have been working with leather for decades, ensuring that the notebook is firm and not easily scattered.
  • Vintage Kraft Paper: The notebook's inner paper adopts a vintage-style kraft paper, complementing the notebook cover. With a thickness of 260 inner pages, it provides a moderate thickness, and the writing experience is smooth without easy printing or dyeing.
  • Giftable and Multi-purpose: Perfect as Mother's and fathers Day gifts, back to school supplies, these leather journals come in gift box packaging and can be used as a hand account book, travel diary, family record book, appointment planner, daily journal, painting book, sketchbook, work record book.
  • Warranty: One-year warranty. In case you are not happy with the product, kindly let us know, and we will work on resolving the issue immediately.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
The Unboxing Alone Blew Me Away
Let’s start with the unboxing, because even that exceeded my expectations. Each journal came in its own individual box, beautifully wrapped in brown parchment with a postcard placed on top. Before you even see the journal, it already feels intentional and special.. like you’re opening a gift, not simply receiving a notebook. Then you unwrap it, and the journal itself is absolutely gorgeous. The quality, craftsmanship, and presentation are far better than I could have imagined. I ordered several of these to give to military Veterans at an upcoming event, and I wanted something that felt meaningful and not cheap, generic, or mass-produced. These are exactly that. The fact that I can preserve the original packaging and recreate that entire unboxing experience for each Veteran makes them even more perfect for what we are doing.

    Beautiful, sturdy journal that lays flat
    Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2026
    Size: 6"x8.1"Color: Dark Brown
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is a beautiful leather journal with a rustic, handmade look. The leather feels soft and good quality, and the journal itself is nice and heavy with thick pages. It’s the perfect size for keeping detailed notes and information without feeling too bulky.

    One of my favorite features is that it lays flat while I’m writing, which makes it very easy and comfortable to use. The wraparound leather tie also gives it a unique, old-fashioned look.

    The only minor downside is that the leather has a slightly chemical smell when first opened. Hopefully that fades after it airs out. Overall, I’m very happy with it and would definitely recommend it.

You likely won’t see any bleed through so you can write on both sides of the page. Sadly though this very nice paper is too rough to work smoothly in concert with a good quality fountain pen nib.

    I don’t regret the purchase, I just wish I hadn’t trusted the description and wish I would’ve tested the pen on the back flab.

About this Item

  • Genuine Leather Design: The leather is soft, smooth, and durable, hand-stitched, making it unique and beautiful overall.
  • Handmade Customized: Each journal is crafted by artisans who have been working with leather for decades, ensuring that the notebook is firm and not easily scattered.
  • Vintage Kraft Paper: The notebook's inner paper adopts a vintage-style kraft paper, complementing the notebook cover. With a thickness of 260 inner pages, it provides a moderate thickness, and the writing experience is smooth without easy printing or dyeing.
  • Giftable and Multi-purpose: Perfect as Mother's and fathers Day gifts, back to school supplies, these leather journals come in gift box packaging and can be used as a hand account book, travel diary, family record book, appointment planner, daily journal, painting book, sketchbook, work record book.
  • Warranty: One-year warranty. In case you are not happy with the product, kindly let us know, and we will work on resolving the issue immediately.

Product Description

Introducing the RILIHO Leather Journal Notebook, a beautifully handcrafted journal made from genuine leather. This notebook features a hand-stitched binding, ensuring durability and a unique aesthetic, Making it perfect for a variety of uses such as a hand account book, travel diary, family record book, appointment planner, daily journal, painting book, sketchbook, or work record book. It also comes in a gift box packaging, making it an ideal gift for special occasions. We stand by the quality of our product and offer a satisfaction guarantee.
